comment: Building kit materials (src/track/BuildingKit). Sources: Poly Haven (CC0). Rebuilt by tools/textures/fetch_textures.py --set buildings, which checks the md5 of every download. tile: world size of one texture repeat (m); the kit maps its UVs in meters divided by tile. heightInAlpha false: the albedo alpha is 1 (the level model shader cuts alpha below 0.5).
